description: GROUPBY dynamic-array group-and-aggregate (Excel 365). Six perspectives spanning bare-name aggregator dispatch (spill), LAMBDA aggregator dispatch (spill), unknown-name ->

cases.skipped: GROUPBY returns a 2D ArrayValue; oracle compare_value only handles scalars. Unit test GroupBy.BareSumName covers bare-name aggregator dispatch and grouping order.
GROUPBY with a LAMBDA aggregator returns a 2D ArrayValue; oracle compare_value only handles scalars. Unit test GroupBy.SingleKeyLambdaAggregatorSum covers inline-LAMBDA dispatch.

Bug-class divergence: Formulon returns #CALC! when filter_array eliminates every row; Mac Excel 365 surfaces #VALUE!. The unit test GroupBy.FilterArrayAllExcludedYieldsCalcError encodes the wrong expectation; a follow-up fix should change the literal at groupby_pivotby_lazy.cpp:632 (and the matching PIVOTBY path at line 1027) from ErrorCode::Calc to ErrorCode::Value, then update the unit test.
